content: कुष्ठः, -ष्ठम् [<ls>Uṇ. 2. 2</ls>] .²1 Leprosy (of which there are 18 varieties); गलत्कुष्ठाभिभूताय च <ls>Bh. 1. 90</ls>. .²2 A sort of poison. .²3 A kind of tree; Costus specious, see कोष्ठ; <ls>Rām. 2. 94. 24</ls>. .²4 ({%m.%}) cavity of the loin. .{@-ष्ठा@} The mouth or opening of a basket.
